text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Meridian pilot kickoff next week. Need enrollment confirmations + enablement slots. Anyone pick up follow-ups?

Raj Patel: I have outreach in progress. 3 accounts confirmed (meridian-co, brightleaf, holt-analytics). Two pending legal review.

Tom Nguyen: Can we confirm they have telemetry keys? Meridian-co asked about sample SDK integration. @Maya can you share quick snippet?

Maya Chen: Posting the snippet below, use the Node SDK init call; also schedule a 30m enablement. ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY})
```

Ava Brooks: I'll run the enablement sessions Mon/Tue 10am PT. Booked in calendars. Will send invite to Meridian contacts.

Raj Patel: Legal might push docs to next week. That could shift onboarding. Marking renewal risk low for now but monitor.

Tom Nguyen: One of the confirmed accounts hit token limits in dry-run; raised issue with infra. @eng-infra FYI.

CS Bot: Reminder: pilot-feedback form posted: https://rwd-labs/surveys/meridian-pilot — prefer responses after first 48h of usage :memo:

Ava Brooks: Quick agenda for enablement: 1) Integration checklist 2) Observability walkthrough 3) Feedback capture (survey + Slack weekly). Any additions?

Maya Chen: Add success metrics: avg latency SLO, cost per 1k tokens, and quality eval pass rate. We'll need these in the kickoff slide.

Raj Patel: Assigning follow-ups: @Ava - enablement; @Tom - SDK + infra blockers; @Maya - account comms + slides. I'll track legal and billing.

Tom Nguyen: Noted. Pushed a quick fix to SDK example. If anyone runs into `ERR_QUOTA` let me know and I'll add debug logs.

Maya Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll send a final readiness checklist tomorrow. Also logging action items to the pilot tracker: https://rwd-sidecar/board/meridian-pilot
